get.summary: Get sandbox and computer provider pricing
get.description: Use this to compare hourly list rates by CPU and memory size, provider billing rules and capabilities, available desktop and phone operating systems, and estimated prices for standard workloads.

get.description: Use this to compare measured start times, verified job runs, parallel request bursts, and provider billing data. Each group identifies the provider and the benchmark methodology.
